source: research/data/source.json (pinned SOTD Index commit, SHA-256 verified on load)

definitions.exact: Dated 2023-01-01 or later and containing no legacy hue swatch. Black and white count as exact here, because from this date Awwwards records exact colors for every entry.
definitions.category: Dated before 2023-01-01, with every recorded color from the fixed legacy palette (white, black, gray and seven hues). These are category choices, not measurements.

exclusions.exact-before-cutover: Exact colors recorded before 2023 (mostly 2022, the transition year). Excluded from the exact dataset because black-and-white records of the same period cannot be told apart from legacy swatches, so including only the chromatic ones would bias the set.
exclusions.legacy-after-cutover: A legacy hue swatch on an entry dated 2023 or later.
exclusions.mixed: Exact and legacy hue colors in one record.
